title: Map Click to Geospatial Address
negative_results: an address without a declared CRS (frame) is refused (invariant 9)
an address without an epoch is refused (invariant 9)
an unknown body (not EARTH/MARS) is refused
an out-of-range latitude or shell is refused
a pixel click outside the viewport is refused, not clamped
a degenerate viewport (min >= max extent) is refused

claims.statement: A direct geodetic click, or a pixel click projected through a declared equirectangular viewport, becomes a typed GeospatialAddress conforming to geospatial_address.schema.json and carrying body, CRS (frame), and epoch; the pixel projection round-trips exactly (POWER).

No pin/address exists without a declared CRS and epoch, and no precision is invented: the direct-click uncertainty is an explicit input and the pixel-click uncertainty is computed from the pixel footprint, never a hidden default.

privacy_check: CLEAN - synthetic fixtures only, no private inputs
